review.head: 526f0e688aaf7ce1e181e7884fc571b3020f8150
review.scope: The six implementation commits were cherry-picked onto current main without conflicts; the release additionally restricts client access to the new internal claim table.
review.correctness: Durable generation intent commits before paid work. Provider/Storage/Sharp work runs without an active booking transaction, then current authorization, cutoff, quota, source revision and lease ownership are checked at acceptance. Receipts and acceptance facts commit atomically; same-key retries do not repeat a paid generation. Both a retained output and an unknown outcome preserve reconciliation evidence.
review.security: Routes and authentication contracts are unchanged. Logs allowlist phase/request metrics only. The new table's RLS denies non-owner row operations even with grants; the companion migration also revokes PUBLIC/anon/authenticated privileges, including TRUNCATE. The runtime connects as table owner. No broader Data API policy redesign is included.
review.architecture: Reuses the existing booking boundary and authorization mechanisms. External work coordinator owns fencing and reservation orchestration shared by generation and derive. Couple and Manager print pages share bounded hydration.
review.performance: No database connection or booking lock is retained while waiting on Gemini or Storage. Claim/journal/acceptance are separate short transactions. Print line/revision hydration is bounded at 1/3/20 orders. Pool limits and transaction timeout are unchanged.
review.readability: Implementation is separated into diagnostics, schema, shared orchestration, timeout and workflow commits. Recovery and cutoff checks remain explicit in the owning service.
review.verification: Exact-head PR and merged-main CI both passed, including PostgreSQL integration, per-file coverage, OpenAPI and dependency audit.
review.apiAndDependencies: No OpenAPI, dependency, CI workflow, Dockerfile or Railway config file changes versus current main.
review.rollback: Prior SUCCESS deployment 0f1dc704-f5ee-4ad0-84e3-d816a53a618e can be redeployed. Retain additive migrations, claims and durable intent/journal history; do not drop evidence. Restore the timeout to 30000 only if requested/required for a rollback; 60000 is compatible with the previous image.
review.limitations: Controlled tests do not prove live Gemini availability or an end-user p95 improvement. Release verification performs migration/config/source/health checks without paid generation or real-money operations. Existing production-readiness RV requirements remain independent.
